group_definition: Connected components of exact same-participant suffix-to-prefix equality over 64 consecutive samples in all three total-acceleration axes
matching_half_block_audit: All identical prefix/prefix, prefix/suffix and suffix/suffix blocks within a participant must remain in one component
rotation: test=k; calibration=(k+1) modulo 5; train=remaining three folds
inner_validation: First of five StratifiedGroupKFold folds inside outer training, shuffled seed=primary_seed+outer_fold
label_use: Stratification and global class support only; no test-outcome tuning
analysis_scope: Secondary single-seed UCI overlap leakage sensitivity; participant overlap allowed; no session or full temporal-independence claim
